differences: The authors' Day 3 vs Day 15 word model has 22 participants (1,488 tokens) although 27 took the Day-15 word test: five Day-15 labels are misspelled in the word file (their script corrects them only after the days are joined), so those participants have no Day-3 partner there. Here they are mapped to their participants, and the 22 is reproduced from the labels as spelled.
The Day-15 word rows labelled Subect18 are attached to Sub18 (the authors' own correction) but carry the group Low, while every other row of Sub18 says High; the label is kept as shared.

The counts of removed tokens in the comments of the authors' scripts are from an earlier version of the data: with the files shared, the vowel steps remove 7 (missing distance), 52, 63, 50, 10, 3 and 10 tokens (comments: 7, 52, 64, 2%, 26, 8, 35), although the analysis sets reproduce the paper's token counts exactly.
The paper's descriptive table (Model 1) is matched to within 0.015 (the shared tokens give means up to 0.01 higher in some cells).
